We aren't just disagreeing on policy; we are speaking different languages regarding the very nature of existence. Until we acknowledge that the definition of a "person" is a boundary line drawn in different places by different souls, we will continue to talk past one another. Perhaps the most honest starting point is admitting that this is a question with no "correct" answer that satisfies every human conscience.
